import bpy,json,math,struct,zlib,numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['facade16'];root=ns['root'];cap=ns['cap'];craft=ns['craft']
assert not craft.get('facade16_facade')
archive=bpy.data.collections.new('F16_Facade_Previous_Components');bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(archive);archive.hide_render=True;archive.hide_viewport=True
def retire(o):
 archive.objects.link(o);craft.objects.unlink(o)
def png(name,a,color=True):
 a=np.round(np.clip(a,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1]
 if a.shape[2]==3:a=np.concatenate([a,np.full((*a.shape[:2],1),255,np.uint8)],axis=2)
 h,w=a.shape[:2]
 def chunk(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
 path=root/'assets/coast/textures'/(name+'.png');assert not path.exists()
 path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+r.tobytes() for r in a),6))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color';im.pack();return im
def pixels(im):
 t=bpy.data.images.load(bpy.path.abspath(im.filepath),check_existing=False);t.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';t.reload()
 a=np.empty(len(t.pixels),np.float32);t.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(t.size[1],t.size[0],4);bpy.data.images.remove(t);return a
def reshape_axis(o,axis,scale):
 o.data=o.data.copy();ps=[o.matrix_world@v.co for v in o.data.vertices];center=(min(p[axis] for p in ps)+max(p[axis] for p in ps))/2;inv=o.matrix_world.inverted()
 for v,p in zip(o.data.vertices,ps):p[axis]=center+(p[axis]-center)*scale;v.co=inv@p
 o.data.update()
windowmat=bpy.data.materials['SP13_ForgedEdgeIron'].copy();windowmat.name='F16_PaintedWindowSteel';p=windowmat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');node=p.inputs['Base Color'].links[0].from_node
a=pixels(node.image);lum=(a[:,:,:3]*np.array([.2126,.7152,.0722])).sum(axis=2);variation=np.clip((lum-lum.mean())*.58,-.045,.045)
a[:,:,:3]=np.array([68,78,79])/255+variation[:,:,None]
node.image=png('F16_PaintedWindowSteel_albedo',a)
for link in list(p.inputs['Metallic'].links):windowmat.node_tree.links.remove(link)
p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=0;p.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.24
front=sorted([o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B clerestory front mullion')],key=lambda o:o.location.x)
assert len(front)==13
removed=[]
for i,o in enumerate(front):
 if i%2==0:removed.append(o.name);retire(o)
cross=bpy.data.objects['Combined_rear_B clerestory front cross'];removed.append(cross.name);retire(cross)
side=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B side window mullion')]
assert len(side)==12
for o in side:
 if min(abs(o.location.y-c) for c in [4.45,6.8])>.01:removed.append(o.name);retire(o)
reframed=[]
for o in list(craft.objects):
 if o.name.startswith(('Combined_rear_B clerestory front','Combined_rear_B side window')) and 'dark glass' not in o.name:
  if 'jamb' in o.name:reshape_axis(o,0 if 'front' in o.name else 1,.70)
  elif 'sill' in o.name:reshape_axis(o,2,.70 if 'front' in o.name else .62)
  else:o.data=o.data.copy()
  o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(windowmat);reframed.append(o.name)
# The former heavy solid corner covers become actual thin folded sheet-metal returns.
corners=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B corner trim')]
assert len(corners)==4
for o in corners:removed.append(o.name);retire(o)
newcorners=[]
for sx in [-1,1]:
 for rear in [False,True]:
  x=sx*3.793;y=8.274 if rear else 2.912;dy=-.151 if rear else .151
  points=[(x-sx*.155,y),(x,y),(x,y+dy)]
  vs=[(a,b,z) for z in [1.58,4.83] for a,b in points]
  faces=[(0,1,4,3),(1,2,5,4)]
  if (sx==1)==rear:faces=[tuple(reversed(f)) for f in faces]
  me=bpy.data.meshes.new('F16 corner folded sheet');me.from_pydata(vs,[],faces);me.materials.append(windowmat);me.update()
  uv=me.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
  for poly in me.polygons:
   for li in poly.loop_indices:
    v=me.vertices[me.loops[li].vertex_index].co;uv.data[li].uv=((v.x+v.y)*.4,v.z*.4)
  ob=bpy.data.objects.new('F16 folded corner '+str(sx)+' '+('rear' if rear else 'front'),me);craft.objects.link(ob)
  sol=ob.modifiers.new('Folded 4mm steel','SOLIDIFY');sol.thickness=.004;sol.offset=0
  newcorners.append(ob.name)
# Broader window bays: seven tall front panes, and four side windows with 2x2 panes.
H,W=512,1024;rgb=np.zeros((H,W,3))+np.array([73,89,90])/255
def glass_region(x0,x1,y0,y1,nx,ny,seed):
 h=y1-y0;w=x1-x0;v,u=np.mgrid[0:h,0:w]/np.array([max(h-1,1),max(w-1,1)])[:,None,None]
 cx=np.minimum((u*nx).astype(int),nx-1);cy=np.minimum((v*ny).astype(int),ny-1)
 pu=(u*nx)%1;pv=(v*ny)%1;edge=np.minimum(np.minimum(pu,1-pu),np.minimum(pv,1-pv))
 variations=np.random.default_rng(seed).uniform(-.03,.03,(ny,nx))[cy,cx]
 dirt=np.exp(-edge*50)*.16
 base=np.array([73,89,90])/255*(1+variations[:,:,None])
 rgb[y0:y1,x0:x1]=base*(1-dirt[:,:,None])+np.array([97,94,81])/255*dirt[:,:,None]
glass_region(0,1024,384,512,7,1,1601)
for j in range(4):glass_region(j*256,(j+1)*256,0,256,2,2,1610+j)
glass=bpy.data.materials.new('F16_WorkshopWindowGlass');glass.use_nodes=True;p=glass.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=0;p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.34;p.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.23
t=glass.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');t.image=png('F16_WorkshopWindowGlass_albedo',rgb);glass.node_tree.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],p.inputs['Base Color'])
lights=[bpy.data.objects['Combined_rear_B clerestory front dark glass']]+sorted([o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B side window dark glass')],key=lambda o:o.name)
assert len(lights)==5
for j,o in enumerate(lights):
 o.data=o.data.copy();o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(glass);uv=o.data.uv_layers.active
 ps=[o.matrix_world@v.co for v in o.data.vertices];axis=0 if j==0 else 1
 lo=min(v[axis] for v in ps);hi=max(v[axis] for v in ps);z0=min(v.z for v in ps);z1=max(v.z for v in ps)
 for li,loop in enumerate(o.data.loops):
  v=ps[loop.vertex_index];u=(v[axis]-lo)/(hi-lo);vv=(v.z-z0)/(z1-z0)
  uv.data[li].uv=(.001+u*.998,.752+vv*.246) if j==0 else (((j-1)+.003+u*.994)/4,.002+vv*.496)
# Keep panel placement, UV and corrosion; reduce the wall profile, separating it from main roof folds.
walls=[o for o in craft.objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials and o.data.materials[0].name=='M15_WeatheredWallElevations']
assert len(walls)==59
wallmat=bpy.data.materials['M15_WeatheredWallElevations'].copy();wallmat.name='F16_WallWeatheredSteel';wallmat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.28
for o in walls:
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box];dx=max(v.x for v in pts)-min(v.x for v in pts);dy=max(v.y for v in pts)-min(v.y for v in pts)
 reshape_axis(o,0 if dx<dy else 1,.64);o.data.materials[0]=wallmat
craft['facade16_facade']=True
ns.update({'archive':archive,'png':png,'pixels':pixels,'retire':retire})
(cap/'facade_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps({'archived':removed,'window_steel':reframed,'folded_corners':newcorners,'glass':[o.name for o in lights],'wall_panels':[o.name for o in walls],'wall_profile_scale':.64,'front_panes':[7,1],'side_panes':[2,2],'main_roof_and_primary_beams_unchanged':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('F16_FACADE',len(removed),'components archived;',len(reframed),'window frames;',len(walls),'wall panels; 2 new textures')
